name: N R Vandana Tex Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, N R Vandana Tex Industries Limited is a Kolkata-based company specializing in the design, manufacturing, and wholesale distribution of cotton textile products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
The company is involved in designing, manufacturing, and wholesaling of cotton textile products, primarily including cotton sarees, salwar suits, and bedsheets. It operates on a B2B model, marketing its products under its brands, “Vandana” and “Tanaya”.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 173 days.
